label: League operations
description: Running the league: registration, rosters, scheduling, safety.
note: Covered by the registration itself; a waiver or permission slip is evidence of it.

label: League communications
description: League emails about the season, to the parent.
note: The NFL FLAG notice says emails collected for parental consent are not used for marketing unless the parent separately opted in (public source: https://nflflag.com/policy).

label: NFL and club marketing
description: Marketing contact by the NFL entities or a club.
note: Needs its own explicit opt-in. A consent email, a waiver or a terms acceptance is never this purpose (purpose limitation).

label: Third-party or partner disclosure
description: Disclosing household data to a partner.
note: Design constraint: for under-13 data the amended COPPA Rule requires separate verifiable parental consent unless the disclosure is integral to the service (public source: Finnegan). Whether a club is a third party is an open question; no feed captures this purpose.

label: Profiling
description: Building a profile of the household for targeting.
note: Residents of Virginia, Colorado and Connecticut can opt out of profiling under the NFL FLAG notice (public source). No feed captures this purpose; it is modelled so its absence is visible.
